name: Pagine Gialle Scraper
description: Pagine Gialle scraper for Python and the command line: Italian businesses for a category and a comune, with the email the owner registered, Partita IVA, verified phone, website, opening hours and address, plus Pagine Bianche listings, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: profiles
commands.help: Pagine Gialle profiles for a category in a comune, with email and VAT id
commands.description: Italian businesses for a category and a comune, read from their Pagine Gialle profile: the email the owner registered, VAT id, verified phone, opening hours.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What the businesses do, as Pagine Gialle names it — e.g. "dentisti", "idraulico", "ristoranti".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many profiles to deliver at most (1–300). You pay only for delivered profiles.

commands.name: directory
commands.help: Pagine Gialle and Pagine Bianche listings for a category in a comune
commands.description: Businesses listed in Italian directories (Pagine Gialle, Pagine Bianche) for a category and a comune or quartiere, including the small ones Google misses.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What the businesses do, as the directory categorises it — e.g. "autonoleggio", "dentista", "idraulico".

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Comune or quartiere — e.g. "Milano", "Milano Quartiere Affori", "Monza".

inputs.name: sources
inputs.description: Directories to read: paginegialle (default), paginebianche, or both, e.g. --sources paginegialle paginebianche.

inputs.name: only_with_phone
inputs.description: Drop and do not bill businesses with no published phone number.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many businesses to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered businesses.
